auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom a2
        WHERE a2.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
          AND a2.XCL_003 = 'F'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM bond b
      WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
        AND b.XCL_006 = '='
  )
